slug: 2026-07-08 FG Halts Enforcement of New Regulations on Internet Platforms

systems.system: Unified national policy and governance framework for the digital economy (proposed)
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, with a joint NCC, NITDA and NDPC technical committee

note: The minister suspended enforcement of new internet-platform regulations pending a harmonised policy framework and set up a joint committee on 7 July 2026; the framework is a regulatory-coordination instrument, not described as a digital strategy, so no fact is recorded.
